data.name: BuildShare
data.shortDescription: Share your buildings with the world.
data.description:
## Introducing Build Share open alpha. Create building prefabs and import them as  blueprints


In the open alpha uploading is not yet supported. For the full release a complete website is planned to browse the buildings online. Uploading and downloading buildings from other people will be possible from in-game.
The current version is available as an open alpha to test the general blueprint creation. You can still share your buildings by sharing the files in the `Sons Of The Forest/Mods/BuildShare/LocalBuildings` folder.

The default key to bring up the panel is `Page Up`, you can change it in the in-game settings (Mods -> BuildShare -> Toggle Key).
You can cancel any action (building selection or placing) with the Escape key.

Placing a building has two modes (which you can switch between with the right mouse button).

Corner Mode: Align the building with with the terrain but trying to keep each lower corner of the building above the ground. Change the height offset with scroll.

Free Mode: Freely place the building anywhere. Change the distance with scroll.
